title: 9 Best Herbal Creams For Post Nasal Drip
intro: Herbal creams for post nasal drip are topical ointments made from various plant-based ingredients, designed to provide relief from the discomfort and congestion associated with excess mucus production in the nasal passages. The benefits of using herbal creams to treat post nasal drip include their non-invasive nature, ease of application, and potential to soothe and calm irritated nasal tissues. Examples of herbal creams that can be effective in treating post nasal drip include those containing eucalyptus oil, known for its decongestant properties, peppermint oil, which can help to reduce inflammation, and thyme oil, which has antimicrobial properties that can help combat underlying infections. Additionally, creams containing ginger, slippery elm, and licorice root are also popular choices, as they have anti-inflammatory and soothing properties that can help to reduce nasal congestion and discomfort.

preparations.preparation_desc: Eucalyptus globulus creams have been traditionally used to treat post nasal drip, a common condition characterized by an excessive flow of mucus from the nasal passages. The anti-inflammatory and decongestant properties of eucalyptus globulus creams help to reduce nasal congestion and alleviate symptoms of post nasal drip. The bioactive constituents of eucalyptus globulus, including eucalyptol, cineole, and limonene, exhibit antimicrobial and expectorant properties that help to break down and clear mucus from the nasal passages. The benefits of using eucalyptus globulus creams to treat post nasal drip include reduced nasal congestion, improved respiratory function, and a decrease in the frequency and severity of symptoms.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the study, Eucalyptus globulus creams for post nasal drip may provide a clinically significant reduction in the severity of post-nasal drip, as assessed by a physician at V2.

preparations.preparation_desc: Echinacea purpurea creams have been used traditionally to alleviate symptoms of postnasal drip, such as excessive mucus production and congestion. Bioactive constituents like alkylamides and caffeic acid derivatives in Echinacea purpurea creams are responsible for its therapeutic effects, which include reducing mucus production and promoting the clearance of excess mucus from the nasal passages. Regular use of Echinacea purpurea creams can provide relief from postnasal drip symptoms, promote sinus health, and boost the immune system, making it a beneficial herbal remedy for this common affliction.

preparations.preparation_study: According to "American journal of otolaryngology", Zingiber officinale creams for post nasal drip may be effective in reducing the severity of rhinorrhea, nasal congestion, and post-nasal drip, assessed by a physician, as it is part of the 5-plant extract BNO 1012, which showed clinically significant reduction in these symptoms.
